sources.title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash launch (552B MoE, CED, KV cache, pricing)
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: DeepSeek Sep 10 introduces V4.1-Flash: 552B MoE CED (8B prefill/16B decode active), native multimodal, 1M context; new pretraining plus larger RL.

DeepSeek reports benchmark results ahead of flagship models including V4-Pro, citing tests by multiple unnamed parties; independent reproduction absent, so comparative performance stays vendor-attributed.
claims.context: Vendor comparative claim with unnamed third parties; not independently established.

claims.text: KV cache 1/4 HBM, 1/8 SSD; live on API as deepseek-flash; V4-Flash/Vision-Exp retired with compat route; MIT weights; partner support stated.

In-window API docs describe a future Sep 14 04:00Z routing of V4-Pro requests to V4.1-Flash until V4.1-Pro; that routing is a post-window future operation, not an occurred W37 event. In-window pricing/economics (peak/off-peak 50 percent, effective Sep 10 04:00Z) are separate occurred facts.
claims.context: Temporal boundary: document in-window, operation post-window.
